answer: A concrete defense is per-identity collateral locked at registration, so a sybil swarm pays the bond once per fake node, not per campaign. Each stake must vest across an epoch, so peers can attest or slash before rewards unlock. A ring minting a thousand shells must fund a thousand locked balances, tying capital up for months and risking the whole pool on one bad attestation, turning cheap multiplication into a real liability. That price drains the ocean of disposable keys, leaving an honest oasis of staked agents as the signal peers trust. A cipher is useless without skin in the game.
